# Private Chef Alexandros

> Private chef (Privatkoch) Alexandros Karimalis cooks dinners in homes, holiday apartments and ski chalets in Salzburg, the Salzburger Land and the Gastein valley (Bad Gastein, Bad Hofgastein, Dorfgastein), Austria. 2–20 guests, from €95 per person; tasting menus from €145. Alpine, Austrian, Greek and Mediterranean cuisine. Background: family restaurant on Ikaria (50 years), private chef in Mykonos villas, five-star resorts. Languages: English, German, Greek. Booking via WhatsApp +30 697 598 5318 or privatechefalexandros@gmail.com.
